title: Working on my extremely niche dream game
author: LightconeGames
selftext:
This is something I always had in mind but was too big and complex to ever fully tackle with my full focus (as I already have a job and this would have been like, another full time job). But now I've decided that it was actually a great use case for Claude.

Orion Arm: a classic roguelike (and I mean *classic*, think Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup) on an Elite or Privateer like game. Go around the galaxy, do whatever, mine, trade, do missions, pirate, the works. Pretty much all of it procedurally generated, not a single thing you see right now on this screenshot is an asset. Barebones graphics, deep mechanics and systems.

Thoughts? Would you be interested in something like this?

replies.author: LightconeGames
replies.body: No, Stellaris is a grand strategy game. In Stellaris you command an entire civilization. This is a RPG, you are a single pilot seeking fortune in the galaxy. Closer comparisons would be Freelancer, Elite: Dangerous, or Star Control.
